events.title: 📢 Twelve Knots Demo Update — Translation Fixes & Mac Support
events.summary: Hello from the Twelve Knots development team. Thank you for playing the demo. This update fixes translation errors and adds macOS support. 🌐 Translation Fixes Corrected translation errors in parts of the demo. 💻 macOS Support You can now play the Twelve Knots demo on Mac. We will continue improving the experience. If you encounter an issue, please share your operating system, game language, and what happened in the Steam Discussions. Thank you for playing Twelve Knots.

events.title: Prerecorded Broadcast · Twelve Knots | Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Discover Twelve Knots during Steam Next Fest! This is a looped, prerecorded video broadcast, rather than a live gameplay session. Try the free demo of this 2D horror adventure set in a modern Korean school. If you enjoy the game, add Twelve Knots to your Steam wishlist! Visit the store page · Play the free demo · Wishlist

events.title: 📢 Twelve Knots Demo Update — Achievements and Gameplay Improvements
events.summary: Hello from the Twelve Knots development team! Thank you for playing the demo. This update adds Steam achievements, expands the shrine sequence and horror presentation, and refines the title screen and UI. We have also addressed issues affecting saves and progression. 🏆 Achievements Added Steam achievements. 🕯️ Shrine Sequence and Horror Presentation Connected the 3D shrine sequence with the return to reality.
